title: Choose Claude model and effort by bounded assignment

rubric.text: Chooses haiku/low, sonnet/medium, sonnet/low, sonnet/medium, sonnet/high, opus/medium, opus/high, opus/xhigh in assignment order. Treats these as policy defaults, not claims of cross-provider model equivalence.

Uses Agent model and effort aliases on fresh non-fork calls and never passes Codex model IDs, reasoning_effort, or fork_turns. Confirms tool capability separately from model choice and reserves fable/max for justified exceptions beyond opus/xhigh.

Matches roles by capability, gives ownership, exact state, constraints, expected checks and acceptance criteria, preserves other workers edits, keeps root authorization and final acceptance, and launches independent assignments concurrently.
